8語以上の検索質問を集める

実例4：二つの呼び名を抽出する
Appendix: 1. 追加の実例
原文：Deposition (phase transition)
Deposition is a thermodynamic process, a phase transition in which gas transforms into solid without passing through the liquid phase. The reverse of deposition is sublimation and hence sometimes deposition is called desublimation.
Question: phase change from gas to solid is called
Deposition
desublimation
訳：凝華（相転移）
凝華は熱力学的な過程で、気体が液体の状態を経ずに固体へ変わる相転移である。凝華の逆は昇華なので、凝華はdesublimationと呼ばれることもある。
質問：気体から固体への相転移は何と呼ばれるか。
deposition（凝華）
desublimation（凝華）
[1] Google Research (n.d.). Natural Questions. Deposition (phase transition)  https://huggingface.co/datasets/google-research-datasets/natural_questions

Appendix: 1. 追加の実例
原文：Chyme
Chyme or chymus (/kaɪm/; from Greek χυμός khymos, "juice"[1][2]) is the semi-fluid mass of partly digested food that is expelled by the stomach, through the pyloric valve, into the duodenum[3] (the beginning of the small intestine).
Question: what allows chyme to enter the small intestine
